roll.10:
23 Jan 2023: Deborah (“Deb”) and Jolene met. Jolene had finished a demanding electrical-engineering project. They bonded over their late mothers: Deb sits by the window bench where her mother read; Jolene’s mother died in 2022 and gave her a heart-shaped bird pendant in Paris in 2010, symbolizing freedom and ambition. Deb wears a memorial pendant. Yoga helped Deb through hardship, and she hoped to keep teaching.

25 Jan–4 Feb 2023: Deb’s father died suddenly on 25 Jan. She felt shell-shocked; family, remembrance, and living fully helped. She shared photos of her parents’ 1993 wedding and hoped to build a loving, supportive family with her husband. Jolene’s snakes Susie and Seraphim comfort her; Seraphim once escaped and curled beside her while she gamed. Jolene games with her partner; they planned to play *The Walking Dead* on 4 Feb. She likes *Sapiens* and Neal Stephenson’s *Avalanche*. Her robotics project involved a sustainable rural water purifier; she hoped to develop community-focused solutions. Deb met yoga neighbor Anna and likes forests, beaches, flowers, and water near her mother’s old home.

9–25 Feb 2023: Jolene’s 1 Feb life-assessment retreat gave her confidence and project ideas. She wanted to organize volunteer STEM workshops for disadvantaged children, but had not contacted groups. Deb’s friend died; a photo of Deb and Karlie on their last hike (summer 2022) comforts her. Deb visited Bali in 2022 and loves beach yoga. Jolene and her partner (together three years, not married) met in engineering class and collaborate; a ring in a photo was decorative. Yoga, meditation, and breathing help Jolene manage stress. Deb meditates, teaches yoga, began jogging on 24 Feb, and values self-care.

2 Mar 2023: Jolene likes lasagna; studies and exams overwhelmed her, and she struggled to prioritize mental health. She had done yoga and meditation the previous Friday. She shared photos of a wooden-floor room/window, purse and plant, Seraphim at the park, and a desk/to-do list. Deb enjoys birdsong and breeze outdoors. Deb advised breaking study tasks into smaller goals and using a planner, offered to help make a study plan, and shared a yellow mug with an encouraging handwritten message. Jolene was cheered up.

13 Mar 2023: Deb had started a neighborhood yoga class and hosted neighbors on Friday; she shared a group photo of women. Yoga calms her, and teaching brings happiness, helps others, and builds friendships/community. Jolene praised her, then asked to discuss time management for Engineering assignments. Deb agreed to find a mutually convenient time; Jolene would check her schedule. Deb offered support and encouraged self-care.

22 Mar 2023: Jolene said exams/deadlines made her feel she was constantly catching up. She used Pomodoro (25 minutes work, 5-minute break) but struggled to prioritize. Deb shared a photo of her day’s to-do list; Jolene showed a photo of her own notes and said a large task list overwhelmed her. Deb introduced the Eisenhower Matrix (sort tasks by importance and urgency), sharing a photo of scissors on a paper; Jolene found the visualization helpful and planned to try it. Deb urged self-care. She said she and Anna had watched a sunset by the sea and realized they inspire each other, then shared a beach photo of someone with a surfboard. Jolene said it made her think of learning to surf. She had gathered information, watched videos, and bought a beginner’s guide, but still needed to find time and a place for a lesson. Deb encouraged her and shared a row of surfboards by a palm tree; Jolene felt motivated to pursue surfing. Deb reminded her to enjoy the experience, step by step.
roll.20:
Deb (Deborah) and Jolene bonded over losing their mothers. Deb’s mother loved art and flowers; they shared a special park bench, talked about dreams, and once watched a sunset in silence. Deb wears a memorial pendant. Jolene’s mother died in 2022; in Paris in 2010 she gave Jolene a heart-shaped bird pendant symbolizing freedom/ambition. Deb’s father died suddenly; she finds comfort in family, memories, and living fully. Friend Karlie died; a 2022 last-hike photo comforts Deb.

Jolene studies electrical engineering, interned, and has snakes Susie (adopted 2021) and Seraphim. She has a boyfriend of three years, met in class; they play games. Engineering projects: rural water purifier, solar vehicle (completed May 2023), affordable aerial-surveillance prototype for emergencies/environment. She hopes to teach STEM workshops. Likes yoga/meditation, surfing, photography, *Sapiens*, Neal Stephenson, lasagna, Nils Frahm, Ólafur Arnalds. Escaped Susie was once found under bed after hours.

Deb teaches yoga, meditates, jogs, loves Bali/nature/beach yoga; has two cats and dislikes dogs. Likes candles/oils, mellow music, mindful walks; offers practical study/productivity advice. Ran mindfulness workshops and organized a yoga event with food stalls/live music. Her peaceful park has forest trail, beach, and meaningful bench.

Jolene has felt overwhelmed by studies/project, relationship, and personal growth; pets, games, yoga, meditation, checklists and visual reminders help. Bought partner an Xbox (17 Aug 2023); likes *Zelda: Breath of the Wild*, *Animal Crossing*, *Overcooked 2* (once won three large pizzas), and received *Battlefield 1* (Aug 2023).

21 Aug 2023: Deb revisited the meaningful bench, brought flowers; felt nostalgia, longing, gratitude. Her mother loved flowers and taught her to slow down, notice beauty, and enjoy simple things. Both value yoga, meditation, mindful walks. Deb calls walks a “reboot.” Jolene’s favorite pose is savasana; she’s practiced yoga for 3 years to unwind from study/work stress and said she was finding her zen again. She shared a green cushion photo and humorous savasana photo.
roll.30:

Beach is where she married/discovered surfing; meaningful park trail/bench and lake.

Jolene’s mother died in 2022; gave her a heart-shaped bird pendant in Paris (2010), symbolizing freedom/ambition. Electrical engineering student: rural water purifier, solar vehicle (finished May 2023), aerial-surveillance prototype; hopes for community-impact STEM/sustainability/clean-water/renewables work. Likes yoga (savasana), meditation, surfing, photography, *Sapiens*, Neal Stephenson, lasagna, Nils Frahm/Ólafur Arnalds, games; snakes Susie/Seraphim. Partner of 3 years, met in class, games together. Both find comfort in nature, reflection, family memories and small joys.

Earlier plans/events: 6 Sep 2023 Jolene/partner signed up for lakeside meditation; 8 Sep Deb’s yoga getaway canceled by storm; coffee planned Friday 5 after books. Jolene described Phuket meditation retreat (12 Sep); Deb invited her to cat-themed card game. 15 Sep Deb reconnected with mother’s friends; Jolene described peaceful yoga space/Thailand flower meditation. 16 Sep Deb and neighbor held free community gardening class; Jolene/partner tried scuba. Deb visited mother’s house/bench 10 Sep; discussed cooking, baking, reading and surfing. Agreed to plan surf outing in October; Jolene to check schedule.

20 Sep 2023: Deb enjoyed music festival with pals, dancing; music recalls mother’s lullabies. Jolene shared photo with partner at festival and said festivals help express herself/escape stress; recently had a yoga retreat with partner, sunrise over valley, felt peaceful, grateful, connected to nature/self. Recalled peaceful waterfall hike with partner; plans nature trip in October. Deb shared spring blossom-tree photo near home; blooms inspired awe, life’s beauty and hope through hard times. Jolene shared plant growing from building, symbolizing resilience/growth; both value small positive things.

Jolene games, reads, and has snakes Susie (adopted ~Aug 2021) and Seraphim (got 2022); pets comfort her. Loves engineering, nature, and music during yoga.
